channel.title: kevinxsec
channel.description: Security research, penetration-testing lab writeups, and technical notes by kevinxsec.

item.title: How This Blog Works (and a Markdown Feature Tour)
item.description: A tour of every Markdown feature this site supports: code blocks, terminal output, tables, callouts, images and captions. Doubles as a reference while writing.

item.title: JWT Algorithm Confusion: How It Happens and How to Prevent It
item.description: Why trusting the alg header in a JSON Web Token lets attackers forge tokens, a minimal vulnerable verifier, a demonstration, and the fix.

item.title: Sample HTB Writeup: Lantern (Fictional Linux Box)
item.description: A template walkthrough for a fictional Easy Linux machine: virtual host discovery, a path traversal that leaks credentials, and a sudo misconfiguration.

item.title: A Practical Nmap Workflow for Lab Machines
item.description: A fast two-stage Nmap workflow for lab targets: find open ports quickly, then run detailed scripts only where it matters, with notes on what each flag does.

item.title: Sample THM Writeup: A Login Form and Union-Based SQL Injection
item.description: A template for a TryHackMe room writeup, walking through authentication bypass and UNION-based SQL injection against a deliberately vulnerable login.

item.title: Sample OffSec Notes: A Repeatable Enumeration Methodology
item.description: A template for OffSec lab study notes: a structured enumeration checklist, note-taking layout and time-boxing rules that keep lab work organised.

item.title: Linux Privilege Escalation Checklist
item.description: A short, ordered checklist for local privilege escalation enumeration on Linux lab machines: sudo, SUID binaries, cron, capabilities and writable paths.

item.title: Sample Project: A Small Recon Notes Helper
item.description: A template for a personal-project post: the problem, the design, a short script that creates a per-target notes directory, and what to improve next.
